document.abstract: This standard describes the signal format of a digital vertical interval time code (D-VITC) suitable for use with the digital coding given in ANSI/SMPTE 125M (for 525-line, 59.94-Hz field rate, 4:2:2 component digital signals) or ITU-R 601-2 (for 625-line, 50-Hz field rate, 4:2:2 component digital signals).
